vsm1.4:87.1: Evamettha vivicceva kāmehīti iminā kāmacchandassa vikkhambhanaviveko vutto hoti.
vsm1.4:87.2: Vivicca akusalehi dhammehīti iminā pañcannampi nīvaraṇānaṃ,
vsm1.4:87.3: agahitaggahaṇena pana paṭhamena kāmacchandassa, dutiyena sesanīvaraṇānaṃ.
vsm1.4:87.4: Tathā paṭhamena tīsu akusalamūlesu pañcakāmaguṇabhedavisayassa lobhassa,
vsm1.4:87.11: dutiyena sesānaṃ catunnaṃ akusalacittuppādānaṃ vikkhambhanaviveko vutto hotīti veditabbo.
vsm1.4:87.12: Ayaṃ tāva vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehīti ettha atthappakāsanā.
vsm1.4:88.1: Ettāvatā ca paṭhamassa jhānassa pahānaṅgaṃ dassetvā
vsm1.4:88.2: idāni sampayogaṅgaṃ dassetuṃ savitakkaṃ savicārantiādi vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:88.3: Tattha vitakkanaṃ vitakko, ūhananti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:88.6: Tathā hi tena yogāvacaro ārammaṇaṃ vitakkāhataṃ vitakkapariyāhataṃ karotīti vuccati.
vsm1.4:89.2: oḷārikaṭṭhena pubbaṅgamaṭṭhena ca ghaṇḍābhighāto viya cetaso paṭhamābhinipāto vitakko.
vsm1.4:89.5: Vipphāravā cettha vitakko paṭhamuppattikāle paripphandanabhūto cittassa
vsm1.4:89.8: Santavutti vicāro nātiparipphandanabhāvo cittassa ākāse uppatitassa pakkhino
vsm1.4:89.10: paribbhamanaṃ viya ca padumābhimukhapatitassa bhamarassa padumassa uparibhāge.
vsm1.4:90.1: Dukanipātaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana ‘‘ākāse gacchato mahāsakuṇassa ubhohi pakkhehi vātaṃ gahetvā
vsm1.4:90.2: pakkhe sannisīdāpetvā gamanaṃ viya ārammaṇe cetaso abhiniropanabhāvena pavatto vitakko.
vsm1.4:90.3: Vātaggahaṇatthaṃ pakkhe phandāpayamānassa gamanaṃ viya anumajjanabhāvena pavatto vicāro’’ti vuttaṃ,
vsm1.4:90.5: So pana nesaṃ viseso paṭhamadutiyajjhānesu pākaṭo hoti.
vsm1.4:91.1: Apica malaggahitaṃ kaṃsabhājanaṃ ekena hatthena daḷhaṃ gahetvā itarena hatthena cuṇṇatelavālaṇḍupakena parimajjantassa daḷhagahaṇahattho viya vitakko, parimajjanahattho viya vicāro.
vsm1.4:91.2: Tathā kumbhakārassa daṇḍappahārena cakkaṃ bhamayitvā bhājanaṃ karontassa
vsm1.4:91.3: uppīḷanahattho viya vitakko, ito cito ca sañcaraṇahattho viya vicāro.
vsm1.4:91.5: majjhe sannirumbhitvā ṭhitakaṇṭako viya abhiniropano vitakko, bahi paribbhamanakaṇṭako viya anumajjano vicāro.
vsm1.4:92.1: Iti iminā ca vitakkena iminā ca vicārena saha vattati
vsm1.4:92.2: rukkho viya pupphena phalena cāti idaṃ jhānaṃ ‘‘savitakkaṃ savicāra’’nti vuccati.
vsm1.4:92.4: ‘‘iminā ca vitakkena iminā ca vicārena upeto hoti samupeto’’tiādinā (vibha. 565) nayena puggalādhiṭṭhānā desanā katā.
vsm1.4:93.1: Vivekajanti ettha vivitti viveko, nīvaraṇavigamoti attho.
vsm1.4:93.4: Tasmā vivekā, tasmiṃ vā viveke jātanti vivekajaṃ.
vsm1.4:94.9: Tattha khuddikāpīti sarīre lomahaṃsamattameva kātuṃ sakkoti.
vsm1.4:94.11: Okkantikāpīti samuddatīraṃ vīci viya kāyaṃ okkamitvā okkamitvā bhijjati.
vsm1.4:95.1: Ubbegāpīti balavatī hoti kāyaṃ uddhaggaṃ katvā ākāse laṅghāpanappamāṇappattā.
vsm1.4:95.2: Tathā hi puṇṇavallikavāsī mahātissatthero puṇṇamadivase sāyaṃ cetiyaṅgaṇaṃ gantvā
vsm1.4:95.4: ‘‘imāya vata velāya catasso parisā mahācetiyaṃ vandantī’’ti
vsm1.4:95.6: sudhātale pahaṭacitrageṇḍuko viya ākāse uppatitvā mahācetiyaṅgaṇeyeva patiṭṭhāsi.
vsm1.4:96.2: ekā kuladhītāpi balavabuddhārammaṇāya ubbegāpītiyā ākāse laṅghesi.
vsm1.4:96.3: Tassā kira mātāpitaro sāyaṃ dhammassavanatthāya vihāraṃ gacchantā
vsm1.4:96.4: ‘‘amma tvaṃ garubhārā akāle vicarituṃ na sakkosi, mayaṃ tuyhaṃ pattiṃ katvā dhammaṃ sossāmā’’ti agamaṃsu.
vsm1.4:96.5: Sā gantukāmāpi tesaṃ vacanaṃ paṭibāhituṃ asakkontī ghare ohīyitvā
vsm1.4:96.6: gharājire ṭhatvā candālokena girikaṇḍake ākāsacetiyaṅgaṇaṃ olokentī cetiyassa dīpapūjaṃ addasa,
vsm1.4:96.7: catasso ca parisā mālāgandhādīhi cetiyapūjaṃ katvā padakkhiṇaṃ karontiyo
vsm1.4:96.9: Athassā ‘‘dhaññāvatime, ye vihāraṃ gantvā evarūpe cetiyaṅgaṇe anusañcarituṃ, evarūpañca madhuradhammakathaṃ sotuṃ labhantī’’ti
vsm1.4:96.10: muttarāsisadisaṃ cetiyaṃ passantiyā eva ubbegāpīti udapādi.
vsm1.4:96.12: ākāsato cetiyaṅgaṇe oruyha cetiyaṃ vanditvā dhammaṃ suṇamānā aṭṭhāsi.
vsm1.4:97.1: Atha naṃ mātāpitaro āgantvā ‘‘amma tvaṃ katarena maggena āgatāsī’’ti pucchiṃsu.
vsm1.4:97.3: ‘‘amma ākāsena nāma khīṇāsavā sañcaranti, tvaṃ kathaṃ āgatā’’ti vuttā āha –
vsm1.4:97.4: ‘‘mayhaṃ candālokena cetiyaṃ ālokentiyā ṭhitāya buddhārammaṇā balavapīti uppajji.
vsm1.4:97.5: Athāhaṃ neva attano ṭhitabhāvaṃ, na nisinnabhāvaṃ aññāsiṃ, gahitanimitteneva pana ākāse laṅghitvā cetiyaṅgaṇe patiṭṭhitāmhī’’ti.
vsm1.4:98.2: pūritavatthi viya mahatā udakoghena pakkhandapabbatakucchi viya ca anuparipphuṭaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:99.1: Sā panesā pañcavidhā pīti gabbhaṃ gaṇhantī paripākaṃ gacchantī duvidhaṃ passaddhiṃ paripūreti
vsm1.4:99.3: Passaddhi gabbhaṃ gaṇhantī paripākaṃ gacchantī duvidhampi sukhaṃ paripūreti kāyikañca cetasikañca.
vsm1.4:99.4: Sukhaṃ gabbhaṃ gaṇhantaṃ paripākaṃ gacchantaṃ tividhaṃ samādhiṃ paripūreti
vsm1.4:99.6: Tāsu yā appanāsamādhissa mūlaṃ hutvā vaḍḍhamānā samādhisampayogaṃ gatā pharaṇāpīti, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā pītīti.
vsm1.4:100.2: suṭṭhu vā khādati, khanati ca kāyacittābādhanti sukhaṃ,
vsm1.4:100.5: Satipi ca nesaṃ katthaci avippayoge iṭṭhārammaṇapaṭilābhatuṭṭhi pīti.
vsm1.4:100.8: Yattha sukhaṃ, tattha na niyamato pīti.
vsm1.4:100.13: Tasmiṃ tasmiṃ samaye pākaṭabhāvato cetaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:101.1: Iti ayañca pīti idañca sukhaṃ assa jhānassa,
vsm1.4:101.2: asmiṃ vā jhāne atthīti idaṃ jhānaṃ pītisukhanti vuccati.
vsm1.4:101.3: Atha vā pīti ca sukhañca pītisukhaṃ,
vsm1.4:101.6: asmiṃ vā jhāne atthīti evampi vivekajaṃpītisukhaṃ.
vsm1.4:101.9: tañcassa atthi, tasmā ekapadeneva ‘‘vivekajaṃpītisukha’’ntipi vattuṃ yujjati.
vsm1.4:101.10: Vibhaṅge pana ‘‘idaṃ sukhaṃ imāya pītiyā sahagata’’ntiādinā (vibha. 567) nayena vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:102.5: ‘‘upasampajjāti paṭhamassa jhānassa lābho paṭilābho patti sampatti phusanā sacchikiriyā upasampadā’’ti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:103.2: tadanurūpena iriyāpathavihārena itivuttappakārajhānasamaṅgī hutvā attabhāvassa iriyaṃ vuttiṃ pālanaṃ yapanaṃ yāpanaṃ cāraṃ vihāraṃ abhinipphādeti.
vsm1.4:103.4: ‘‘viharatīti iriyati vattati pāleti yapeti yāpeti carati viharati, tena vuccati viharatī’’ti (vibha. 540).
vsm1.4:104.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ, vicikicchāti imesaṃ pañcannaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ pahānavasena pañcaṅgavippahīnatā veditabbā.
vsm1.4:104.6: Na hi etesu appahīnesu jhānaṃ uppajjati.
vsm1.4:104.8: Kiñcāpi hi jhānakkhaṇe aññepi akusalā dhammā pahīyanti,
vsm1.4:105.3: Kāmacchandābhibhūtaṃ vā taṃ na kāmadhātuppahānāya paṭipadaṃ paṭipajjati.
vsm1.4:105.4: Byāpādena cārammaṇe paṭihaññamānaṃ na nirantaraṃ pavattati.
vsm1.4:105.8: Iti visesena jhānantarāyakarattā etāneva pahānaṅgānīti vuttānīti.
vsm1.4:106.1: Yasmā pana vitakko ārammaṇe cittaṃ abhiniropeti, vicāro anuppabandhati,
vsm1.4:106.2: tehi avikkhepāya sampāditappayogassa cetaso payogasampattisambhavā pīti pīṇanaṃ,
vsm1.4:106.4: Atha naṃ sasesasampayuttadhammaṃ etehi abhiniropanānuppabandhanapīṇanaupabrūhanehi anuggahitā ekaggatā
vsm1.4:106.6: tasmā vitakko vicāro pīti sukhaṃ cittekaggatāti imesaṃ pañcannaṃ uppattivasena pañcaṅgasamannāgatatā veditabbā.
